Interface ExchangeConnector

All Superinterfaces:
AccountBalanceSource, InstrumentMetaDataProvider, OrderBookSubscribable, TradeServiceProvider, TradingFeeProvider
public interface ExchangeConnector extends InstrumentMetaDataProvider, OrderBookSubscribable, TradeServiceProvider, AccountBalanceSource, TradingFeeProvider
The connector-level surface of an exchange: the providers whose types come from the underlying connector library rather than from the engine's own model.

These used to sit directly on ExchangeSupport, which every strategy-side and runtime component sees. That made the connector library part of the contract for code that has no business knowing which library the engine talks to — an offline backtest stub had to return a fake trade service and a fake order book, and the runtime manager had to name account and market DTOs it only ever passed straight through. Grouping them here keeps ExchangeSupport engine-typed and confines these types to the exchange-adapter modules, where they belong.

Only a live exchange adapter implements this. Everything else reaches it through ExchangeSupport.getConnector(), which is empty when there is no exchange behind the support — as in an offline backtest, where every one of these calls had no meaningful answer anyway.
